subject: english
title: Smooth Reading · Q3 W12 D01
objective: Read grade-level sentences accurately, smoothly, and with meaning.
introduction: Milo has a new mission! 🐱✨ Good fluency combines accurate words, a steady pace, and expression that matches the meaning. Ready to explore? Try the skill with a caption for a drawing.
